provenance.what: The three official maps' raw token grids, as the platform itself reports them.
provenance.channel: line 2 (zero-based index 1) of an official full-information game log is the raw token grid: json.loads(lines[1]) yields 17 rows of 17 single-character token strings, '0' open, '1' wall, '2' outer-gold hotspot.  This asset stores each row joined into one 17-character string, the same shape sim/maps.json uses, so the two can be compared byte for byte.
provenance.extracted_from: 18 zero-quota self-play probe games run on the platform 2026-08-11: a full-vision probe (vp=2, i.e. 9x9 sight, both units walked to fixed anchors and then stood still) against an 'idle' sparring partner. 6 games per official map; three anchor groups whose union covers all 289 cells.
provenance.line2_is_constant_per_map: the 6 logs of each map carry byte-identical line 2
cross_checks: map1 and map2 token rows are byte-identical to the pre-existing sim/maps.json 'rows', which were built from a different set of 142 and 45 local logs -> the extraction channel reproduces two known maps with zero error.

map3 walls are cell-identical to the pre-existing sim/maps.json 'wall_rows', which were decoded from src/player.cpp BAKED_W[2]; the walls_sha256 c5c432003c7a2e4cd3cbc2928a2cd132bed831dc91e126ffc1123af5df2e54ec is unchanged by adding the token-2 markers.
each map has exactly 20 token-2 cells and exactly 5 of them per windmill region (region_id 2,3,4,5) -- including map3, whose token-2 geometry is otherwise structurally unlike map1/map2.
provenance.refutes: the former sim/maps.json map3 note 'Only walls are recoverable from BAKED_W; no log-line-2 bomb-candidate definition is available.' -- line 2 of any platform log carries it.
provenance.map3_geometry: map3's 20 token-2 cells are four runs of five at the edge midpoints: (0,6..10), (16,6..10), (6..10,0), (6..10,16). map1 and map2 instead scatter mirrored pairs around the perimeter.
